verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a Railway CLI, an MCP server, and Agent Skills, but nothing mentions official language SDKs or client libraries, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path. The CLI and MCP server are separate capabilities and earn no credit for an SDK story. Official SDKs are a fair question for a cloud platform, so this is 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
